Industrial property for sale and lease in Abbotsford: warehouses, industrial buildings, shop condos and industrial strata units listed on the MLS®. Space for lease is included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.
Where Abbotsford’s industrial growth is planned

items.t: The City’s 2017 Industrial Land Strategy found Special Study Areas A and B had the highest potential for new industrial land: Area A suited to large logistics, warehousing and distribution users, and Area B, near Mt Lehman Road and the airport, to smaller and medium-bay industrial businesses. ([City of Abbotsford, Industrial Land Strategy (April 2017)](https://www.abbotsford.ca/sites/default/files/2021-02/Industrial%20Land%20Strategy.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 4 of the 18 commercial sales in Abbotsford were industrial properties, against 81 across the Lower Mainland.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Industrial space in the Abbotsford submarket (10.7M sq ft) was 4.5% vacant in the third quarter of 2026, asking $17.12 per sq ft net plus $5.73 in additional rent, with 142,400 sq ft under construction. Across Metro Vancouver vacancy was 4.0%.
Source: Avison Young, Metro Vancouver industrial market report, Q3 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
Abbotsford zones that allow industrial uses
Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.

faq.q: How many industrial properties sold in Abbotsford recently?
faq.a: 4 in the second quarter of 2026, out of 18 commercial sales in Abbotsford (GVR Commercial Edge).
